paper_title: Riding the dark matter wave: Novel limits on general dark photons from LISA Pathfinder
notes: Paper presents NEW measured exclusion limits from LISA Pathfinder using auxiliary channel data (SC-TM differential acceleration). Main result is for B−L dark photon dark matter in mass range 4×10^-19 eV < m < 3×10^-17 eV, providing world-leading limits. The coupling values shown are mass-independent (flat) bounds over the stated validity range. Paper uses ρ_DM ≃ 0.4 GeV/cm³ for local DM density. The y-axis in Figures 3-5 shows gauge coupling g_BL = ε_BL × e in units of GeV^-1 (from Lagrangian ε_g e A'_μ J^μ_g). However, the paper also discusses rescaling to other gauge groups (B, Le−Lμ, etc.). The solid red/green/orange lines in Fig. 3 represent the main LPF Apr 2016 data results; dashed blue line is a forecast with improved sensitivity. The paper emphasizes this is a parametrically improved search compared to previous decoherence-based methods, with ~12 orders of magnitude enhancement. Polarization treatment uses 'envelope simplification' (lower envelope of three axes × 1/√3 factor) for visualization and comparison with literature. A more rigorous analysis accounting for full 3D sensitivity and orbital information is outlined as future work.
